briefdescription.para: Translates time in seconds to a YEAR:MON:DAY HR:MIN:SEC format.

detaileddescription.para: Saves the translated time in the DT structure variable. It also reports the weekday.

parameterdescription.para: Time value that has to be shown in DateTime format.
DateTime format variable that stores the translated time.

simplesect.para:
This API uses Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) as reference. It supports years from 1970 to 2106 (unsigned 32-bit limit).
WEEKDAY CONVENTION: WeekDay field follows POSIX standard: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, 4=Thursday, 5=Friday, 6=Saturday. 1970-01-01 (epoch) was Thursday, so WeekDay = 4.
For u32 input, overflow is impossible. Maximum timestamp (0xFFFFFFFF) correctly converts to 2106-02-07 06:28:15.

briefdescription.para: Translates time in YEAR:MON:DAY HR:MIN:SEC format to seconds.

detaileddescription.para: The result is the number of seconds since Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a DateTime format structure variable of time that has to be converted to seconds.

simplesect.para: Seconds value since Unix epoch (1970-01-01).
This API uses Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) as reference. Input must be in range 1970-2106. The input structure is not modified. This is the inverse of XRtcPsu_SecToDateTime().

briefdescription.para: Calculates the calibration value depending on the actual real-world time.

detaileddescription.para: It also helps in deriving a new calibration value if the application changes the oscillator frequency. TimeReal must be the accurate reference time in seconds since Unix epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC). This matches standard internet time sources (NTP, GPS, and so on) and can be used directly without conversion.

parameterdescription.para: Actual real-world time in seconds since Unix epoch (1970-01-01). You can obtain it from network time protocols (NTP) or other accurate time sources. The value must be greater than the current time of the RTC for calibration to work correctly.
New oscillator frequency. If using the typical 32768Hz crystal, input the same frequency value.

simplesect.para: After calculating the calibration register value, the application must call the CfgInitialize API again to apply the new calibration into effect.

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the driver and hardware device.
